headline: Looking for something to do this weekend? Here are the Top 5 local events for Oct. 10-11
teaser: Fall festivals in Palm City and Stuart, Tradition Unlocked, early trick-or-treating in Jensen Beach and a Sunday concert in Fort Pierce lead the Oct. 10-11 weekend picks.
body:
The Treasure Coast's first big October weekend brings two days of fall festivals, an outdoor craft fair, a community-wide preview in Port St. Lucie and an early Halloween outing for families. Here are five events worth considering for Saturday, Oct. 10, and Sunday, Oct. 11.

## 1. Newfield Harvest Festival, Palm City

**When:** Saturday and Sunday, Oct. 10-11, noon to 6 p.m. each day. **Where:** Newfield Fields, Palm City. **Admission:** Free.

Newfield's first annual Harvest Festival offers a full weekend of fall activities, with a Ferris wheel, pumpkin picking, a hay maze and hayrides among the attractions listed by organizers. Live music, local vendors and family activities round out the two-day celebration.

The festival is a strong choice for families looking to spend an afternoon outdoors rather than squeeze multiple stops into a single outing. [Event details](https://discovermartin.com/event/1st-annual-newfield-harvest-festival/2026-10-10/).

## 2. Downtown Stuart Fall Craft Festival, Stuart

**When:** Saturday and Sunday, Oct. 10-11, starting at 10 a.m. each day; scheduled through 5 p.m. Sunday. **Where:** Osceola Street, downtown Stuart. **Admission:** Free.

The 27th annual Downtown Stuart Fall Craft Festival brings an outdoor art and craft show to Osceola Street in the historic waterfront district. Visitors can browse the displays and explore nearby downtown shops and restaurants during the festival weekend.

The event offers an easy way to make a day of downtown Stuart, whether the main draw is handmade goods or a walk around the waterfront area. [Event details](https://discovermartin.com/event/27th-annual-downtown-stuart-fall-craft-festival/).

## 3. Tradition Unlocked, Port St. Lucie

**When:** Saturday and Sunday, Oct. 10-11; activities are scheduled across the weekend, with individual stop times varying. **Where:** Multiple locations in Tradition, Port St. Lucie. **Admission:** Free.

Tradition Unlocked invites households to explore several venues for a preview of activities and events planned for next year. Each stop reveals something different, and visitors can complete a Tradition Passport by visiting the participating locations for a chance to enter a drawing.

Because the program spans several stops, check the daily itinerary before heading out. [Saturday details](https://traditionfl.com/events/tradition-unlocked-day-1/) and [Sunday details](https://traditionfl.com/events/tradition-unlocked-day-2/).

## 4. Trick or Treat Stroll, Jensen Beach

**When:** Saturday, Oct. 10, 4-6 p.m.; members may enter at 3:30 p.m. **Where:** Children's Museum of the Treasure Coast, Jensen Beach. **Admission:** $3 per person ages 1 and older, including members and nonmembers.

The Children's Museum gets an early start on Halloween with its Trick or Treat Stroll. The Saturday afternoon event offers families a seasonal outing well ahead of Oct. 31, with the museum setting the price at $3 for children and adults ages 1 and up.

Families planning to attend should review the organizer's event information for any participation details before leaving home. [Event details](https://discovermartin.com/event/trick-or-treat-stroll-4/).

## 5. Tribute to Chicago and Other Great Horn Bands, Fort Pierce

**When:** Sunday, Oct. 11, 1-4 p.m. **Where:** Summer Crush Vineyard & Winery, Fort Pierce. **Admission:** Listed at $18.50.

Sunday afternoon brings a horn-driven concert to Summer Crush, celebrating the music of Chicago alongside songs associated with groups and artists such as Earth, Wind & Fire, Blood, Sweat & Tears, Steely Dan and Santana. The performance adds a live-music option to a weekend otherwise heavy on fall festivals and family activities.

Check current admission and availability with the venue before making plans. [Event details](https://visitstlucie.com/event/tribute-to-chicago-and-other-great-horn-bands-like-ewf-steely-dan-blood-sweat-tears-santana-more-2/).

For additional listings across Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, visit the [Treasure Coast Today events calendar](https://treasurecoast.today/events.html).
